approvedAssertions: M1 read is exactly 58 task-read operations; getOperationsWorkspaceLoginEntry remains a protocol read and never loads workspace read authorization facts.
M2 is exactly two C5 session-selection commands plus 58 task reads; generic commands are not inferred applicable from consumer face.
All 83 GET operations have an explicit disposition: 78 task reads receive request-scope budget policy and five protocol/content reads remain a closed exemption set.

The only primaryQueryCap>1 rows are the 10 owner-projection exceptions frozen by the phase4 owner-projection rebaseline; every projection boundary has logicalStatementCap=1 and all other 68 task reads remain cap=1.
Platform audit preserves the actual branch boundary: GROUP_WORKSPACE plus five workspace-host entity types require EnabledSelectedWorkspaceFact; PLATFORM_ADMIN does not.
C5 command reconciliation is limited to WorkspaceAuthenticationService selectContext/selectDataNode after mutation; it does not reuse task-read facts or WorkspaceSessionRequestCache.
